S6: public local asset URLs are read through the site container with paths and queries preserved; remote public origins remain unchanged. A queued retry sharing a failed original build request owns the quickstart fence; cancellation and a different revision remain blocked. S7: strict-first variant planning is deterministic and balances source clusters, never relaxes subject or resolution constraints; identical derivative bytes upload once while every reference is patched/read back. Variant receipts finish as needs-review without chat or Outreach. S8: accepted_at fixes the retry deadline; stale/superseded/foreign/cancelled actions cannot renew it. Old/uncertain provider attempts block; live parallel attempts of this action proceed. No new intent or allowance is created. S9: vanilla receivers are refused before upload; source logo roles alone cannot authorize required/undeclared fields. Retry never adopts editor text or missing records, and only resumes verified photo snapshots. Technical numbers require trusted frozen-record metadata, remain unchanged and never waive factual semantic roles; alt prefix normalization is auditable and preserves the original paid input hash. S10: Edited or missing records and uncertain mutations are refused. Human term edits, missing CAS, missing mutation receipts and association drift cannot pass. Verified term receipts resume without another model call or write. S11: popup uses the existing gallery/preview; no Add site/chat/design-choice write. Fresh single and bulk requests require a valid CMS/template selection; exact release identity survives database serialization and retries.
